themes.title: Far-right parties exploit migration crises for political gain
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are leveraging the recent migration crisis in Ceuta, Spain, to push anti-immigration policies and criticize mainstream governments. This theme is evident in Spain, Italy, and other EU countries where leaders are calling for stricter border controls and rejecting EU-wide solutions.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Criticizes Spain's handling of the Ceuta migration crisis, demands stronger border controls, and rejects EU redistribution plans for migrant minors.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italy's PM Meloni and Deputy PM Salvini criticize Spain and Germany for migration policies, demand stricter EU-wide controls, and reject NGO rescue operations.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Jordan Bardella supports stricter migration policies and criticizes EU's handling of migration crises.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage and Reform UK use migration as a key campaign issue, advocating for stricter border controls and deportation policies.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Criticizes Norway's immigration policies and advocates for stricter controls and deportation measures.

themes.title: Right-wing governments target social programs amid fiscal debates

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Proposes cuts to social programs, including Medicaid and Head Start, while increasing defense spending and reducing taxes.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Advocates for significant reductions in welfare spending and social programs, framing these cuts as necessary for economic growth.

countries.note: Sweden Democrats influence national policies, particularly on immigration and integration, as part of a right-wing coalition government.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Jordan Bardella's leadership solidifies RN's position as a dominant far-right force in France, influencing national debates on immigration and security.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Norway's Progress Party leads in polls, shaping national debates on immigration, climate policy, and economic issues.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Criticizes vaccine mandates and advocates for parental choice in vaccination, aligning with broader anti-vaccine rhetoric.
